caution_findings.evidence_context: Local XML/PDF/supplement/database rows contain qRT-PCR expression data and database labels, but no MIC/MBC/hemolysis/cytotoxicity values.

DRAMP04418 exact 44-aa sequence and B6RQP4 linkage are present in database rows, while the local primary article/supplement text supports INF-217 as a defensin-like transcript and GenBank accession EU282115 without embedding the exact mature peptide sequence.
INF-42, INF-163, and INF-165 have weak AMP similarities and are not promoted beyond source-stated qRT-PCR expression rows.
